notes.title: Moving Out 2 is Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/mTKw9uT.gif[/img]

[h2]THE VAN’S PACKED, THE SINK’S...SOMEWHERE, AND IT’S TIME TO GO, MOVING OUT 2 LAUNCHES TODAY!
[/h2]

SMG Studio, DevM Games, and Team17 Digital have today launched couch moving co-op game Moving Out 2!

Featuring online crossplay multiplayer, Moving Out 2 sees the Furniture Arrangement and Relocation Technicians (F.A.R.Ts) head beyond the realms of their dimension and go multiversal, tackling futuristic furniture, fantastical finery, and frantic farm animals as they keep their cool, lift with their spine, and transport almost everything in one piece. 

[b]Everything’s packed except this brand-new launch trailer:[/b]

[previewyoutube=lquKsZmuEZU;full][/previewyoutube]

[u][b]Moving Out 2 Key Features
[/b][/u][list]
[*] Location, location, location: Travel the multiverse and overcome new levels and puzzles that pit F.A.R.Ts with their biggest removals challenge yet.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/64tj8sJ.gif[/img]

[*] Co-op Continued: Players can either take on Moving Out 2 solo or with friends (or enemies) in both couch and cross-play enabled online co-op.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849904/13cdcdf8d1fdfa953f6ac7b451e2b9352e816c50.gif[/img]

[*] Assist mode: Movers of all abilities are welcome in Packmore; with Assist Mode, the possibilities (and fun) are endless, and inclusive!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/khRrs43.gif[/img]

[*] Zany characters: Featuring a whole new host of smooth movers, Moving Out 2 showcases entirely new characters that will both enchant and horrify.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OMnXmp2.gif[/img]
[/list]
So there we go! You know what to do! Sign up to join Smooth Moves and become the ultimate F.A.R.T you can be, either solo or with your friends and family and help the residents of Packmore and beyond by putting on a moving masterclass and purchase Moving Out 2 today!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uWPFgax.gif[/img]

[url=https://discord.gg/qwD6HBMhru][u][b]Click this link to get on board the Smooth Moves Van on its destination to our official Discord server![/b][/u][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34085797/3cdb10ed146028163e872a5d71fdcf4f75dcfb61.png[/img]

notes.title: Moving Out Monday #23 – Employees of the Month(s)
notes.content:
Hey Movers! 
 
Last week we introduced you to Sprinkles and Dials, two stellar Smooth Moves employees full of gumption and grit. Today we thought we’d introduce you to the last two characters that round out the Employees of the Month pack, so please give a warm welcome to this kooky koala and his old-world octopus friend. 


[img]https://i.imgur.com/OL2si6g.gif[/img]


[h3]Introducing, Bruce and Prof. Inkle! [/h3]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/40Nywkm.gif[/img]


[b][i]Bruce[/i][/b]

………...Oh! Sorry, Bruce fell asleep again. He has a habit of drifting off in the middle of conversations... currently the team’s expert on moving beds...soft, fluffy beds... He’ll get back to work soon...after a quick 20 hour nap… 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bg1cHNB.gif[/img]


[i][b]Prof. Inkle[/b][/i]

Nobody is really sure what Professor Inkle is a professor of or who hired them. They just show up on time with their own uniform, ready to jump into the deep end! Old Blackwiskers seems to have a bad past with Inkle, but the story is shrouded in mystery. 


[img]https://i.imgur.com/AtDuOlr.gif[/img]


Now, with the workforce additions of Sprinkes, Dials, Bruce and Prof. Inkle, you’ll have a full new roster to complement your already impressive Smooth Moves ensemble! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/W1MGESu.gif[/img]


[h3][b]You can grab the Employees of the Month pack here: [/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1249280/Moving_Out__The_Employees_of_the_Month_Pack/

 
Let us know in the comments which employee tickles your fancy and why! 
 
Until next time, 
Move Outwards

notes.title: Moving Out Monday #22 – Employees of the Month
notes.content:
Hey Movers! 
 
Last week we waxed lyrical about the Moving Out soundtrack, but this week we wanted to introduce you to two of the extra characters you can snag to play the game! 
 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/0kHfiRl.gif[/img]


Firstly, when it came to character creation, the artists had so much fun! Concepting and then building the characters was a highlight for our artists, and everyone had so many ideas. So many, in fact, that they couldn’t all make it out the door for release.  

As with everything in Moving Out, these characters have some great... character, so without further ado, we'd like to welcome the dynamic duo of a devious donut and a tattletale TV!  

Introducing, Sprinkles and Dials! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ixKiQgs.gif[/img]


[b][i]Sprinkles [/i][/b]

Beware! Here comes Sprinkles! A supervillain, but also too sweet to be taken seriously. Their dastardly deeds include being TOO nice of a friend and moving TOO MANY chairs! Fear their kindness! Soon you will be their best friend! Muahahaha! 
 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/60ss5FB.gif[/img]


[b][i]Dials [/i][/b]

No matter what’s going on in the world, Dials is always tuned in. A serious news junky, they love breaking news about the global moving industry. Just don’t stand too close. The volume knob is stuck at 11! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/X00SMoX.gif[/img]


Now when all is said and done, you’ll find that this duo lend themselves beautifully to the repertoire of current characters in the game. 

Next week you’ll make the acquaintance of two more characters in The Employees of the Month Pack, so join us then to meet your new work-mates! 
 
Until next time, 
Move Smoothly 

[h3]Pick up The Employees of the Month Pack![/h3]

notes.title: Moving Out Monday #16 – Dual Mover Mode
notes.content:
Hey Movers,

With the game coming out on the 28th – YEP! That’s tomorrow! – we wanted to highlight a really… interesting feature that is pretty unique to our game.

Introducing:

DUUUUUAAAL MOOOOOOOOVERRRR MOOOODDDDE

I like the sound of that, I hear you say, but what is it? Well, DMM is an Advanced Mode that allows one person to wield TWO movers with ONE controller! We know, that’s crazy!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZYYXBxa.gif[/img]

Like all good things, there was a need for this. Our designers, having to test levels with multiple players, couldn’t really do that alone. Enter the most complicated testing tool we ever created. The functionality to play multiple characters with a single controller was absolutely invaluable to our designers, and they loved it so much that they wanted to share it with everyone!

We also wanted to give solo players access to the two-player content, and without DMM there would have been no easy way to do that.

Now, we want to be really clear here. This mode is HARD! It’s not for everyone. We can’t stress that enough. It requires an almost impossible -to-achieve level of controller mastery and your spatial awareness game must be en pointe.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/c1V77V4.gif[/img]

As this mode is so difficult, we’ve made sure you have to intentionally enable it in the Settings Menu, first. Once you do you’ll see the option to join as Dual Movers. Now we did say this was HARD, so we added a warning screen when you join as Dual Movers because we’re slightly terrified for you. If you’re positive you want to give it a shot… well, we aren’t responsible for the brain explosion that is likely to ensue. You have been warned…

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Z4yYKF6.gif[/img]

Here’s the really cool thing. You can use a combination of Dual Movers plus individual players controlling characters 3 & 4 or if you want to get really fancy, you can even have two sets of Dual Movers, which allows two players to control four movers simultaneously. Yeah, you might need to re-read that sentence.

We did say this was HARD, right?

To help with any bruised egos, we really want to emphasise that our developers have been using this mode to test the game for a really long time and they can still struggle with it themselves. Even recording content for this Blog: FAIL!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TbvucVk.gif[/img]

To reiterate… it’s very, very HARD!

As for how to use this mode, you can switch which side of the controller is the primary mover and we have a handy UI dashed indicator so you always know which character is the left/primary mover, even at a glance.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lghq3EV.gif[/img]

With extensive experience under their belts, our developers suggest always keeping your primary mover to the left of the secondary mover, or you’ll be asking for a whole world of left/right spatial awareness confusion! If you do happen to get your wires crossed, it’s ok, we have you covered – just tap that toggle button to swap and you’ll be back to ‘normal’ in no time.

As this mode is, you know, so HARD, you can always try Dual Mover in combination with Assist Mode options to make things a little more manageable.

When all is said and done, this is a really weird and wacky mode, but maybe that difficulty is just the challenge you’ve been looking for. Maybe it’s something you really want to master. So sure, it might be HARD, but you can always try to go HARDER!!

Dual Mover Mode is something we’re proud to share with you, our super engaged players, and you’ll find it there waiting for you, so make sure you update on launch day and you’ll get these extra goodies as well:

[list]
[*] New Dance moves with the option to choose which dance you want to move your mover!
[*] A whole lot more Character Customisation options
[*] 4k support for PS4
[*] New and updated Art on heaps of levels with new particle effects included
[*] Random license plates for your Smooth Moves Truck
[*] Milliseconds added to the Game Timer for those extra competitive types among us
[*] Split Keyboard allowing for two players to use the one keyboard on PC
[*] Multi-user Achievements
[*] Awarding bonus challenges retroactively
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fA1loVB.gif[/img]

We are so excited to bring this game to you on April 28th 2020. Oh my goodness, that is TOMORROW! Let us know in the comments what you think about DMM or any of the Day Zero updates and we can’t wait for you to play Moving Out!

Team SMG,

Moving Out from home (just like everybody else in isolation)

notes.title: Moving Out – Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Grab your co-op buddies, we’ll be Moving Out on April 28th![/b][/h2]

[previewyoutube=9lIEghdJQUI;full][/previewyoutube]

In Moving Out, you’ll be relocating furnishings in increasingly bizarre locations in a fast-paced furniture moving simulator that brings a whole new meaning to ‘couch co-op’!

[h3]Features[/h3]
[b]Character Customisation.[/b] Choose from a roster of movers and style them to suit you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34085797/fc701c66fb138396b3772a4e1dddf23eeb18e838.jpg[/img]

[b]Assist Mode.[/b] Increased time limits, skippable levels and removal of dangers are just some of the options available in assist mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34085797/76129d73282e8790f548cb1e7a64e18fa3341098.jpg[/img]

[b]Accessibility Options.[/b] Dyslexia friendly mode, scalable user interface, multiple controller mappings (Steam has fully remappable controls) and subtitles have all been implemented in game to make the experience as inclusive as possible.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34085797/89318b512a5a29862c0f96bc9e90734ae0a2aba5.jpg[/img]

[b]Local co-op.[/b] Players can either take on Moving Out solo or enlist the help of up to three friends as they figure out the quickest way to get a CRT TV to the bottom of a double-storey building without breaking it. Steam players will also be able to utilise the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay#together]Steam Remote Play Together[/url] features to play with their friends over the internet! 

[b]Location, location, location.[/b] No move is too big, too small, or too weird. Move through sleepy suburbs, frenzied farms, haunted houses and even head into space to keep customers happy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34085797/89910777cb82510829bbbe894ec4df5364e47df1.jpg[/img]

[b]Physics.[/b] Need to get a large item of furniture down some steps? Gravity is your friend! Glass door in your way? Smash right through it! Throwing things over railings will always be quicker than carrying them the long way around.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WyzbAB4.gif[/img]

Moving Out comes to Steam on April 28th 2020!

[i]Keep up to date with the latest Moving Out news:[/i]
[url=https://twitter.com/MovingOutGame]Moving Out on Twitter[/url]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/MovingOutGame]Moving Out on Facebook[/url]
